sloka: एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही क्रुद्धा संरक्त लोचना ।अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् रहिते राक्षस अधिपम् ॥३-४८-२०॥
transliteration: evam uktā tu vaidehī kruddhā saṁrakta locanā ।abravīt paruṣam vākyam rahite rākṣasa adhipam ॥3-48-20॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, Sita was enraged and her eyes turned red. She replied in harsh words to the chief of the demons in that solitary place:.
